description: This file defines hooks and utility functions for interacting with the trainer-related API endpoints in a gym management system. It includes functions to list, add, and remove trainer clients, as well as to fetch recent client logs.

methods.name: getTrainerBase
methods.description: Returns the base URL for trainer API endpoints, typically ending with /api/v1.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL from a given path, ensuring proper formatting.

methods.name: listTrainerClients
methods.description: Fetches a list of clients assigned to the current trainer, with fallback to a general trainers endpoint.

methods.name: addTrainerClient
methods.description: Assigns a new client to the trainer via POST request, accepting email or user_id.

methods.name: removeTrainerClient
methods.description: Removes a client from the trainer's list via DELETE request.

methods.name: listRecentClientLogs
methods.description: Retrieves recent activity logs for the trainer's clients, with fallback to an empty list.
